treatments.name: HydraFacial Elite MD
treatments.shortDescription: Medical-grade hydradermabrasion that cleanses, exfoliates, extracts and infuses intensive antioxidant serums.
treatments.fullDescription: HydraFacial Elite MD uses patented Vortex-Fusion technology to unclog congested pores, dislodge impurities, and saturate the skin with hyaluronic acid, peptides, and potent botanical antioxidants. Perfect for instant radiance with zero downtime.
treatments.seoTitle: HydraFacial MD Treatment in Delhi NCR | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Experience instant glow and deep pore cleansing with authentic HydraFacial Elite MD at Skinfinity Derma clinic.

process.title: Fuse & Protect

faqs.q: How often can I take HydraFacial?
faqs.a: Recommended once every 4 to 6 weeks for optimal skin health.

treatments.name: Fractional CO2 Laser Resurfacing
treatments.shortDescription: Gold standard laser treatment for deep acne scars, rough texture, and skin tightening.
treatments.fullDescription: Fractional CO2 laser vaporizes micro-thermal zones in the dermis, stimulating rapid neo-collagenesis and remodeling scar tissue. Dramatically smoothens deep rolling and boxcar scars while rejuvenating skin tone.
treatments.seoTitle: Fractional CO2 Laser for Acne Scars | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Erase stubborn acne scars with US-FDA approved Fractional CO2 Laser therapy by expert dermatologists.

process.title: Laser Resurfacing
process.desc: Micro-columns of laser energy precisely delivered across treatment zones.

process.title: Cooling & Barrier Cream
process.desc: Cryo-soothing followed by post-laser restorative healing balm.

treatments.suitability: Patients with moderate to severe acne scars, deep fine lines or rough skin texture.
treatments.aftercare: Expect mild redness and tiny micro-crusts for 3-5 days. Keep moisturized with prescribed balm.

faqs.a: Typically 3 to 5 sessions spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart.

treatments.name: Q-Switched Nd:YAG Laser Melasma & Glow
treatments.shortDescription: Advanced laser toning that targets deep melanin clusters to clear hyperpigmentation and sun damage.
treatments.fullDescription: The Q-Switched laser emits ultra-short nanosecond pulses of light that shatter stubborn melanin pigments into microscopic particles easily eliminated by the body's lymphatic system. Safe for all Indian skin types.
treatments.seoTitle: Q-Switched Laser Toning for Pigmentation | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Clear melasma, sun freckles and dark patches with painless Q-Switched Laser Toning.

process.title: Skin Cleansing

process.title: Laser Delivery
process.desc: Uniform toning passes across facial pigmentation clusters.

process.title: Calming Mask
process.desc: Application of calming sheet mask and sunscreen.

treatments.suitability: Anyone dealing with stubborn melasma, hyperpigmentation, tanning or post-inflammatory marks.
treatments.aftercare: Strict sun protection with SPF 50+. Avoid scrubbing or harsh actives for 48 hours.

faqs.a: No, it feels like tiny warm rubber band snaps and is very tolerable.

treatments.name: GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate) Hair Therapy
treatments.shortDescription: Next-generation concentrated autologous growth factors engineered to stop hair thinning and stimulate follicles.
treatments.fullDescription: GFC is an advanced evolution over traditional PRP, yielding high concentrations of PDGF, VEGF, EGF and IGF-1 completely free from red and white blood cells. Significantly reduces hair shedding and increases hair shaft thickness.
treatments.seoTitle: GFC Hair Regrowth Therapy | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Stop hair fall and activate dormant follicles with high-potency GFC therapy at Skinfinity Derma.

process.title: Blood Collection
process.desc: Small blood sample collected in specialized sterile GFC activator tubes.

process.title: Centrifugation
process.desc: Tubes incubated and centrifuged to separate concentrated growth factors.

process.title: Micro-Injections
process.desc: Painless micro-delivery across target scalp thinning areas.

treatments.suitability: Men and women facing early to moderate hair thinning or excessive hair loss.
treatments.aftercare: Do not wash hair for 24 hours. Avoid heavy sweating or workouts on treatment day.

faqs.q: How is GFC different from PRP?
faqs.a: GFC delivers a pure, standardized concentrate of growth factors without pain or inflammation.

treatments.name: Triple Wavelength Soprano Laser Hair Reduction
treatments.shortDescription: Painless, cooling laser hair reduction combining Alexandrite, Diode and Nd:YAG wavelengths.
treatments.fullDescription: Utilizing in-motion technology and ICE contact cooling, our triple wavelength system safely destroys hair follicles at varying depths, suitable for all skin tones without burns or discomfort.
treatments.seoTitle: Painless Laser Hair Removal in Delhi | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Get silky smooth, hair-free skin permanently with painless Soprano Laser Hair Removal.

process.title: Pre-shave & Marking
process.desc: Area sanitized, shaved and marked into grids.

process.title: Cooling Gel
process.desc: Chilled ultrasound gel applied for smooth gliding and thermal comfort.

process.title: In-Motion Laser Pass
process.desc: Continuous laser energy delivered to uniformly disable hair roots.

treatments.suitability: Unwanted hair across face, underarms, arms, legs, chest, back or full body.
treatments.aftercare: Avoid hot showers or saunas for 24 hours. Apply soothing aloe vera gel as required.

faqs.a: Yes, ICE contact cooling keeps the skin chilled at -3°C for a soothing experience.

treatments.name: Carbon Laser Hollywood Peel
treatments.shortDescription: Celebrity-favorite laser facial that tightens enlarged pores, removes blackheads, and reduces oiliness.
treatments.fullDescription: A medical-grade liquid carbon suspension is applied to penetrate deep into pores. The Q-Switched laser then vaporizes the carbon particles, exploding away debris, sebaceous clogs, and dead keratinized cells for immediate glass-skin luminosity.
treatments.seoTitle: Carbon Laser Peel Treatment in Delhi NCR | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Unclog pores and get red-carpet radiance with authentic Hollywood Carbon Laser Peel.

process.title: Carbon Paste Layer
process.desc: Nano-carbon mineral lotion applied and allowed to bind with sebum.

process.title: Laser Vaporization
process.desc: Short nanosecond laser pulses gently blast away the carbon and impurities.

process.desc: Hydrating aloe-panthenol biocellulose mask to restore dermal barrier.

treatments.suitability: Ideal for oily, congested skin, open pores, or prior to important celebratory events.
treatments.aftercare: Zero downtime. Use oil-free sunscreen and avoid heavy makeup for 12 hours.

faqs.a: Only very mild flushing that settles within 30 minutes.

treatments.name: Morpheus8 & Microneedling RF (MNRF)
treatments.shortDescription: Subdermal adipose remodeling device delivering fractional RF energy to tighten skin and lift jowls.
treatments.fullDescription: Morpheus8 combines micro-pins with fractionated radiofrequency thermal energy up to 4mm depth, remodeling sub-dermal fat and inducing profound collagen synthesis for jawline contouring, neck laxity, and deep scar smoothing.
treatments.seoTitle: Morpheus8 Microneedling RF in Delhi | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Non-surgical facelift and deep scar remodeling with US-FDA approved Morpheus8 RF.

process.desc: Micro-insulated pins penetrate targeted depth delivering uniform RF heat.

process.title: Post-Care Serum

treatments.suitability: Moderate facial skin laxity, jowls, submental fullness, and stubborn atrophic acne scars.
treatments.aftercare: Tiny grid marks resolve in 2-4 days. Cleanse gently with non-soap cleanser.

faqs.a: Initial tightening starts at 3 weeks, peak collagen remodeling occurs at 3 months.

treatments.name: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) Scalp Therapy
treatments.shortDescription: Autologous plasma rich in platelets that stimulates dormant miniaturized hair roots.
treatments.fullDescription: PRP therapy utilizes concentrated bioactive proteins from the patient's own blood. Platelet degranulation releases PDGF, TGF-beta, and VEGF directly into the dermal papilla, halting excessive shedding and nourishing weakening follicles.
treatments.seoTitle: PRP Hair Loss Treatment in Delhi NCR | Skinfinity Derma
treatments.seoDescription: Stimulate natural hair regrowth with doctor-performed PRP therapy at Skinfinity Derma.

process.title: Sample Collection
process.desc: Small venipuncture to collect 10-15 ml of autologous blood.

process.title: Double Spin Centrifugation
process.desc: Precision density separation to isolate platelet-rich buffy coat.

process.title: Subdermal Delivery
process.desc: Micro-injections delivered with fine insulin needles across thinning areas.

treatments.suitability: Men and women with early to moderate androgenetic alopecia or post-fever hair shedding.
treatments.aftercare: Resume normal activities next morning. Keep scalp clean and dry for 12 hours.

faqs.a: A typical protocol comprises 4 to 6 sessions spaced 1 month apart.

treatments.name: Advanced Medical Chemical Peels
treatments.shortDescription: Targeted dermatological peels (Salicylic, Glycolic, TCA Cross) for acne, marks, and texture.
treatments.fullDescription: Physician-compounded peeling solutions designed to safely exfoliate damaged epidermal layers. We formulate specific acids: Salicylic for active acne, Glycolic & Mandelic for uneven tone, and focal TCA Cross for ice-pick scars.
treatments.seoTitle: Chemical Peels for Acne & Pigmentation | Skinfinity Derma

faqs.a: Light superficial peels produce mild flaking; deeper peels may cause 2-3 days of sloughing.
